# Windows profile registration and retained grant owner

Root and Guard invariants apply. Owner/load: windows-profile/always; trigger: this subtree. Named independent security/API review of the exact unsafe change is required before adoption. No unsafe Send/Sync.

- Only mod.rs owns production CreateAppContainerProfile (fresh host-owned name, empty capability array/count), DeleteAppContainerProfile (that exact owned name), and FreeSid (once for its returned allocation). Reject NUL. No existing-name adoption/enumeration. Null-SID success cleanup preserves exact name/status. Checked deletion preserves owner on failure and disables second deletion after success; Drop is best effort, not retirement proof.
- Native SECURITY_CAPABILITIES borrows the live registration. Registered backing must remain stable through DeleteProcThreadAttributeList, not merely CreateProcess. Runtime retains process/Job/resume ownership and its inherited-duplicate close boundary.
- Only grant.rs owns GetSecurityInfo, SetEntriesInAclW, SetSecurityInfo, LocalFree, GetLengthSid and GetAce for retained filesystem grants. It also owns FileIdInfo queries and explicit-rights DuplicateHandle using GetCurrentProcess. Borrow live registration; bound SID/ACL/ACE extents before copying. Publish/read back the same retained destination. Preserve owner/control and unrelated ACE bytes; independently check actual package SID/mask/flags. publish_observed failure retains destination custody; no automatic retry.
- Grant publication requires exclusive mutation custody. Descriptor readback is point-in-time, not sealing, effective-access, namespace exclusion, authenticated admission or Strict. No grant to installed sources. Reduced receipts retain same registration/object; re-read after writer close. Failures retain custody. No trust/token/launch operations added here. Inline SAFETY; native failure controls and independent readback required. Retire each allowance with its API.

- Strict claim needs pristine profile and owns writes; legacy rechecks before publish.
